rationale: A multi-domain RAG AI assistant requires a focused, premium, and authoritative environment. The deep navy background provides a sleek 'command center' feel, while the neon accents (Indigo, Emerald, Amber) dynamically shift the UI's mood based on the domain. Glassmorphism elevates the interface from basic SaaS to a high-end AI tool.

rules.code: font-mono text-sm tracking-tight text-slate-300 bg-black/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-white/5
rules.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400

layout.spacing: Generous padding: use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Deep gaps (gap-8, gap-12) between major sections.
layout.radius: rounded-2xl for major containers, rounded-xl for inner elements.
layout.alignment: Optical alignment with strong left-aligned text for readability in chat.
layout.chat_structure: Full-width message rows with subtle background separation instead of playful chat bubbles. User messages: transparent bg. AI messages: subtle bg-white/5. Strong contrast for streamed text.

surfaces_and_effects.signature_element: The accent color of the active vertical MUST bleed into the chat input border, source cards, and active tab pills via subtle box-shadows or gradients.
surfaces_and_effects.hover_states: Interactive elements lift (-translate-y-1) with increased backdrop saturation and brighter border.

components.tabs: Pill-shaped tabs (Auto | Finance | Health | Education). Active state has glassmorphism bg + bottom 2px border of the vertical's accent color.
components.chat_input: Glassmorphism input field at the bottom. The border glows subtly with the active vertical's accent color on focus. Use Lucide icons for submit.
components.source_cards: Collapsible citation cards. Header shows similarity score and chunk title. Border-left uses active vertical accent color. Content is in JetBrains Mono.
components.document_upload: Dashed border dropzone (border-white/20). On drag over, border turns to the selected vertical's accent color. Internal tags for Finance, Health, Education.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use the active vertical's accent color with white text. Secondary buttons use glassmorphism.
components.sidebar: Darker than main bg (e.g., bg-black/20) with a 1px right border (border-white/5). Lists past conversations.

motion_and_interactions.chat_streaming: Cursor blinking effect at the end of streaming text.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-out for color shifts when changing verticals.
motion_and_interactions.loading: A pulse or glowing ring using the active vertical's accent color (The 'Thinking/Loading' indicator).

hero_background.description: Abstract dark navy tech background with smooth waves for landing page.

empty_state_owl.description: Use the owl emoji or a Phosphor icon (Owl) for the Athena empty state logo as requested.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='vertical-tab-finance', data-testid='upload-dropzone').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js / React layout with a Sidebar on the left and Main Chat/Upload area on the right.
Implement a global state or Context for the 'active vertical' (auto, finance, health, education) so the UI color can dynamically shift.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the dynamic chat structure and layout. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions like Tabs, Dialogs (upload modal), and Dropdowns.
The empty state should prominently feature 'Ask Athena anything — Finance · Health · Education — auto-routed or pick a domain above' with the Athena Owl motif.
Ensure the Chat Input border and Source Cards dynamically apply the active vertical's color (e.g., border-[#6366F1] for Finance).
Implement Document Upload drag-and-drop zone with vertical tagging.
Include JWT auth mock screens (Login/Signup) using glassmorphism cards centered on the dark navy background.
